description: This header file declares functions for integrating Lua scripting with the lighttpd server, specifically for handling 'liValue' objects and managing Lua stack interactions.

methods.name: li_lua_init_value_mt
methods.description: Initializes the metatable for 'liValue' objects in Lua.

methods.name: li_value_from_lua
methods.description: Converts the top value from the Lua stack into an 'liValue' object and pops it.

methods.name: li_lua_push_value
methods.description: Pushes an 'liValue' onto the Lua stack; returns 1 normally or -1 on error, pushing nil.

methods.name: li_lua_togstring
methods.description: Converts a Lua value at a specified stack index to a GString object.
